text:
sara: Running the KV-cache marathon fuzz job overnight (1000k steps, mixed sequence lengths). Observed steady memory growth on node gpu-rt-07 after ~120k steps. Attaching summary and a tiny repro.
eli: Ugh. Is this the fragmentation pattern we saw last month or something new? any diff vs baseline of compaction pass?
marco: Looks different. Baseline compaction cleared regularly. This run shows allocation spikes aligned with long-context ops (seq>8k). Sample from heap profile: 'kv_region_alloc 43.2MB -> 47.9MB' repeated.
tanya: Reproducer command I used: `./tools/kv_marathon --duration=6h --seq-dist=long-tail --store=malloc`
sara: repro and a tiny flame snippet pasted below. note the large number of small free/list nodes: 
```
# flame excerpt
kv_alloc_fragmentation: 31% (dominant in region 2)
hotspot: kv_put_shard() -> shard_insert_chain()
allocs: 2.1M small_blocks (<=256B)
```
eli: That points at reuse not coalescing free nodes. Is our free-list per-shard or global?
marco: Currently per-shard locked freelist. We tried global early on but hit lock contention. But per-shard freelist causes fragmentation if long-running contexts hold odd-sized segments.
tanya: I ran the synthetic-regression suite with quantized flag on and got identical growth. Config snippet: `kvcache.compaction_interval_ms=120000` and `kvcache.max_frag_threshold=0.18` — still reproduces.
perf-bot: CI kvcache-endurance (pr/834) failed: mem-growth > 8% over baseline on linux-gpu. Full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/834/kvcache-endurance
marco: PR 834 touched kernel-selection path (fast-path for fused attention) — could be interaction between new kernel's KV layout and our compaction assumptions.
eli: Good catch. Can we run a small A/B: run marathon with old kernel vs new kernel and diff heap profiles?
sara: On it. I'll queue two runs on small scale (50k steps) to compare: 1) kernel=v2-old-layout, 2) kernel=v3-fused. Expect results in ~45m.
tanya: Also adding a focused test to the regression harness that exercises many small allocations + long prefix reuse. Suggest name: 'kvcache: small-block churn + longprefix'. I'll add as flaky->blocked until we triage.
marco: If fragmentation is the culprit, short-term mitigation: increase compaction frequency and add a metric for free_list_avg_run_length so we can alert earlier.
eli: I can add the metric to telemetry, also a unit test to simulate alternating long/short sequences to force fragmentation.
sara: Action items: eli add telemetry + unit test; tanya add harness test and block on regressions; marco evaluate kernel layout impact and try global freelist experiment; I'll run the AB small-scale jobs and paste profiles.
perf-bot: Noted. Created ticket PERF-1192 for follow-ups and linked CI failures.
marco: One more note — when trying global freelist in local, latency tail jumped for 95p due to lock contention under high QPS. Might need sharded-global hybrid; will prototype.
sara: Thanks all. Will update with AB run diffs. :thumbsup:
